name: Hildelve's Journal
summary: In Dun Morogh, Hildelve's Journal bears the last words of a dwarf lost to a fierce bear. Its pages tell of the attack and his plea for vengeance.

sections.title: A Pilot's Final Words
sections.body:
Dwarven pilot Hildelve went alone into Dun Morogh after his steam tank broke down. He left his partner, Hammerfoot, with the tanks and searched the snow-swept crags for rumored chiron ore. In his journal, Hildelve writes that Mangeclaw, a monstrous ice claw bear, stalked him for days before attacking.

Hildelve fought bravely and drove the bear off, but Mangeclaw mauled him and left him gravely wounded in the cold. His final hours were agonizing. Before the bear returned, Hildelve made one plea: whoever found his body should hunt Mangeclaw and avenge his death.

sections.title: Return to the Siege Brigade
sections.body: Pilot Hammerfoot, Hildelve's comrade, is stationed near North Gate Outpost in eastern Dun Morogh. Hammerfoot belongs to the Ironforge Siege Brigade and feared the worst when his partner did not return from the search for ore. The journal and Mangeclaw's severed claw prove that Hildelve's final wish has been honored and his spirit put to rest.

faq.answer: Hildelve was a dwarf who piloted a steam tank for the Ironforge Siege Brigade. After his tank broke down, he went alone into Dun Morogh in search of chiron ore. Mangeclaw killed him before he could return.

Mangeclaw is an unusually large, savage ice claw bear that stalks Dun Morogh's snowy ridges. The bear ambushed Hildelve while he was stranded and mauled him severely. Then Mangeclaw returned to end his life.

faq.q: Who receives the journal once it is found?
aliases: where do i take the journal
faq.answer: Pilot Hammerfoot receives the journal. Hildelve's comrade is a siege engine pilot stationed near North Gate Outpost in eastern Dun Morogh. He had sought word of the missing pilot.

faq.q: What does Hildelve ask for in the journal?
faq.answer: Hildelve asks whoever finds his remains to hunt Mangeclaw and avenge his death. In the journal's final pages, he names the beast that attacked him and makes his plea, knowing his wounds are mortal.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can honor the unyielding spirit of pilots who brave freezing weather and wild beasts to secure the heights of Khaz Modan.
As an Alliance member, you strengthen the bond between the Alliance and the Ironforge Siege Brigade by recovering the personal effects of fallen soldiers like Hildelve.
